reignFields.raw: 858-823 BCE<ref>His accession year was the remaining of 859/858 BC (Year 0), while his 35 regnal years started on April 858/857 (Year 1, 1 Nisan) into April 824/823 BCE (Year 35). The Battle of Qarqar in Year 5 (854/853 BC). Assyrians started their regnal year on 1 Nisan with the Akitu Spring Festival (new year) in April.</ref>
